## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.optionalOperandOptions property

Letters from [EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.operandOptions](./sh-analysis.embeddedcommandinterpreterspec.operandoptions.md) whose separate operand may be omitted before a word beginning with `-` or `+`<!-- -->. An attached operand still belongs to the option. For example, ksh93u+ treats `-o -c cmd` and `+o -c cmd` as an operand-free option listing followed by `-c`<!-- -->; bash, dash and zsh consume `-c` as the option name. A dynamic potential operand makes this distinction undecidable.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly optionalOperandOptions?: readonly string[];
```
